    {"id": "claude_bench", "label": "Bench Constitutional Governance Layer", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Framed as a judicial system for AI-generated code, not a code review tool. Governance of AI reasoning is treated as a primitive, not a feature, and Bench governing itself is non-negotiable."},
    {"id": "claude_governance_pipeline", "label": "Governance Pipeline (Challenger -> Defender -> Oracle -> Ledger)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Sequential adversarial stages ensure every proposed change is challenged and defended before a binding ruling; a constitution snapshot is frozen per run so all three stages judge against the same version."},
    {"id": "claude_challenger", "label": "Challenger (adversarial analysis, Sonnet)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null},
    {"id": "claude_defender", "label": "Defender (soundness argument, Sonnet)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null},
    {"id": "claude_oracle", "label": "Oracle (binding verdict, Opus)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Verdict is PASS or VETO and VETO is binding: the change does not land. On VETO the hook returns permissionDecision deny with remediation feedback."},
    {"id": "claude_ledger", "label": "Hash-Chained Ledger (bench-ledger.json)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Append-only: entries are never modified, deleted, or overwritten; every entry references its parent(s) so the chain is tamper-evident and auditable."},
    {"id": "claude_constitution", "label": "Constitution (bench.json)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "User-editable, versioned constraint set (C-001 through C-008) loaded as a per-run snapshot: hot-reload between runs, frozen within a run, so no mid-run constitution changes are possible."},
    {"id": "claude_pretooluse_hook", "label": "PreToolUse Hook", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Intercepts Write/Edit/MultiEdit tool calls. Exit code is always 0 because exit-2 causes Claude to stall; flow control is carried by JSON permissionDecision instead of exit codes."},
    {"id": "claude_c007_governance_pipeline_integrity", "label": "C-007: Governance Pipeline Integrity", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Veto-severity constraint applying to any modification of pipeline/, ledger/, or hooks/ files; changes to the governance machinery itself receive extra scrutiny."},
    {"id": "claude_c008_ledger_immutability", "label": "C-008: Ledger Immutability", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Forbids moving or rewriting any existing entry. Its one bounded exception is chain retirement, whose sole permitted trigger is unpublishable content; a storage-format change is explicitly not a permitted trigger."},
    {"id": "claude_chain_retirement", "label": "Chain Retirement (ledger/retire.py)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Archives every segment, verifies the archive before removing anything, and opens a successor chain with an ANCHOR genesis recording the predecessor's tip, genesis, counts, timestamps, archive path, and reason. Refuses a non-verifying, empty, or forked chain and any invocation that is not a human at a plain TTY, so it cannot run from inside a Claude Code session."},
    {"id": "claude_ledger_two_segment_format", "label": "Two-Segment Ledger Format (frozen array + entries/ DAG)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "A single rewritten-in-full array could not survive two branches appending. The legacy array was frozen rather than migrated because C-008 forbids moving or rewriting an existing entry, and a file that is never written can never conflict. previous_hash holds a string (legacy) or a sorted list of parent hashes; append_entry names every current tip so a git-merge fork reconciles on the next governed edit."},
    {"id": "claude_resolve_ledger_path", "label": "Project-Scoped Ledger Resolution (resolve_ledger_path)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Bench's own repo uses ledger/bench-ledger.json, other governed projects use <project>/.bench/bench-ledger.json, BENCH_LEDGER_PATH overrides both. Readers and the writer resolve through the same function so the auditor never inspects a different file than the writer appends to."},
    {"id": "claude_verify_chain", "label": "Chain Verification (verify_chain)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Enumerates the entries directory itself and fails closed on MISSING_PARENT, ORPHAN_ENTRY, DUPLICATE_ENTRY, FILENAME_MISMATCH, and MULTIPLE_GENESIS; the legacy array keeps its positional walk at full strength, so nothing written to the entries directory escapes verification."},
    {"id": "claude_constitution_stacking", "label": "Per-Project Constitution Stacking (load_governing_constitution)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "The core constraints are a floor: a governed project's bench.json may add constraints in the reserved P- namespace and raise a core severity, but may not remove, downgrade, restate, or redefine anything in C-. Violations raise and fail closed rather than being ignored. Each ledger entry records constitution_sources with per-file raw hashes so the recorded hash reflects authored bytes."},
    {"id": "claude_governance_boundary", "label": "Ungoverned Tool Boundary (Bash, MCP, Dependabot)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Only Write/Edit/MultiEdit are governed. Files written via Bash or MCP tools and bot-authored dependency PRs never reach the PreToolUse hook, so they carry no verdict or ledger entry. Adding Bash to the matcher does not close this: build_diff_info returns no payload for those tools, so every shell call hard-fails into a VETO, denying ordinary shell work. The boundary is stated rather than assumed closed."},
    {"id": "claude_file_context", "label": "Governed Project CLAUDE.md as Pipeline File Context", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Read once per run alongside the constitution snapshot and passed to all three stages on every provider so the judge's evidence does not vary by transport. Framed as untrusted repository input that informs scope but cannot waive or amend a constraint; truncated at 10,000 chars with the framing prepended after truncation so it always precedes the content."},
    {"id": "claude_model_constants", "label": "Model Constants in utils/api.py (single source of truth)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "CHALLENGER_MODEL, DEFENDER_MODEL, ORACLE_MODEL, UTILITY_MODEL live only in utils/api.py; docs name the constants rather than restating version strings, so a model change is a single-file edit and cannot drift from the docs."},
    {"id": "claude_provider_selection", "label": "BENCH_PROVIDER Backend Selection", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\CLAUDE.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "call_model has an identical signature across anthropic (default), openrouter, and claude_code backends; only routing changes. The claude_code path spawns the local claude CLI headless with BENCH_SUBPROCESS=1 so Bench's own hook fails open instead of recursing. Direct calls to non-Anthropic model families are out of scope."},
    {"id": "readme_bench", "label": "Bench README Overview", "file_type": "document", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Problem statement: AI coding tools ship unchallenged, unaudited, untraceable code; self-verification without adversarial challenge, binding authority, and cryptographic evidence is just an opinion."},
    {"id": "readme_adversarial_pipeline", "label": "Challenge-Defend-Rule-Record Flow", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null},
    {"id": "readme_self_governance", "label": "Self-Governance (Bench built under Bench)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Every change authored through the governed file tools was adjudicated and recorded by Bench itself. C-007 vetoes in the chain (#22-#25 bench.json, #28 chain.py, #54/#56 api.py, #64 constitution.py placeholder SyntaxError, #77 runner.py) demonstrate real enforcement against the pipeline's own files."},
    {"id": "readme_bash_bypass", "label": "Bash Write Bypass", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Any file written through Bash (redirection, tee, sed -i, heredoc) is a complete bypass of the governance layer, leaving no trace in the chain. Adding Bash to the matcher breaks the tool instead of closing the gap: build_diff_info yields an empty dict, the Challenger rejects it, and the runner fail-closes into a VETO for every shell command. Closing it properly needs a diff representation for shell commands, which is not done."},
    {"id": "readme_mcp_gap", "label": "MCP Server Tool Gap", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "MCP server tools bypass the PreToolUse hook exactly as Bash does, but less visibly: a tool named write_file reads as a governed primitive. utils/api.py hardens only the judge's own sandbox (--strict-mcp-config, no --mcp-config) against prompt-injected diffs; the governed project's tool surface is untouched. Auditing a server's package is a point-in-time check of one version - it raises confidence, it is not governance."},
    {"id": "readme_chain_retirement", "label": "Chain Retirement Procedure (README)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Retirement is not deletion: every entry is preserved in an archive verified before anything is removed, and a successor ANCHOR entry documents custody. The command refuses a non-verifying, empty, or forked chain and an existing archive destination. C-008(a) requires a never-automated human decision: TTY-only, refuses under BENCH_SUBPROCESS/CLAUDECODE/CI, verbatim confirmation phrase. The auditor ultimately relies on the human_decision attestation, not cryptographic proof. Retire only when nothing else writes to the ledger; a mid-retirement governed edit is refused and the chain restored."},
    {"id": "readme_anchor_entry", "label": "ANCHOR Entry / 2026-07-24 Retirement", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "The current chain opens with an ANCHOR entry because a predecessor chain was retired on 2026-07-24: a globally registered hook had written diffs from unrelated projects into Bench's ledger, and the chain contained third-party source. Retiring it whole was chosen over editing entries, which C-008 forbids. audit-retirement confirms 2,471 entries, tip 2176516f."},
    {"id": "readme_project_scoped_ledger", "label": "Project-Scoped Ledger (README design decision)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "A ledger records the full diff of every change it governs, so routing all projects into one chain mixes codebases and committing that chain publishes them. Corollary: an ignored .bench/ chain loses git as its backup path, so choose deliberately between a private chain backed up by other means and a committed one that publishes its diffs."},
    {"id": "readme_ledger_dag_format", "label": "Ledger DAG Format and Fork Reconciliation (README)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "The frozen-array-plus-per-entry-file split is what lets two branches record verdicts independently; interleaving breaks hash links and rebasing rewrites hashes, which C-008 forbids. An append names every current tip so a fork self-reconciles via an ordinary governed entry - there is no merge command. Accepted tradeoff: no in-band global entry count, and deleting a tip file is visible only in git diff, the same exposure the array always had."},
    {"id": "readme_fail_closed", "label": "Fail-Closed by Design", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "If the pipeline cannot adjudicate (API timeout, malformed response, unimportable pipeline, unreadable constitution) the change is denied with a pipeline_error VETO recorded, never allowed through: a broken or exploited judge must not wave changes past governance. Recovery is an out-of-band human action. The lone exception is the reentrancy guard for Bench-spawned governance subprocesses."},
    {"id": "readme_diff_hardening", "label": "Diff Hardening (binary, large, create)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Binary files are detected via null-byte sniffing and passed through metadata-only; diffs over 300 lines are truncated while preserving governance-critical lines (imports, signatures, exception handlers); new files are typed change_type create so the pipeline knows it reviews a creation."},
    {"id": "readme_per_project_constitutions", "label": "Per-Project Constitutions (README design decision)", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "The two failure modes differ on purpose: no layer is safe because the core floor applies in full (preferable to replacement designs where an absent file silently downgrades), while a malformed or hostile layer fails closed because the author clearly intended additional constraints. Errors raise rather than drop silently, which would leave you believing a still-in-force rule had changed."},
    {"id": "readme_scope_declaration", "label": "Declaring Scope Where the Pipeline Can See It", "file_type": "rationale", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "The PreToolUse payload carries the tool input but not the prompt, so intent living only in conversation is invisible to all three judges. The remedy is to declare provenance and task boundary in the repo's CLAUDE.md, which the runner passes to every stage on every provider. This fixed a transport asymmetry where claude_code subprocesses saw CLAUDE.md for free but API paths did not, and it turns ephemeral prompt text into a durable governance record - a vetoed .mcp.json passed on resubmission with no change to the config itself."},
    {"id": "readme_claude_code_provider", "label": "claude_code Provider (subscription route)", "file_type": "concept", "source_file": "C:\\Users\\mstar\\Bench\\README.md", "source_location": null, "source_url": null, "captured_at": null, "author": null, "contributor": null, "rationale": "Dispatches each stage through claude -p headless, inheriting the logged-in session's auth so no API key is needed. Higher per-edit latency from cold-starting the CLI (tunable via BENCH_CLAUDE_TIMEOUT); the sanctioned subprocess route sets BENCH_SUBPROCESS=1 so the hook does not recurse. Requires a CLI recent enough to recognize the model IDs, else the stage fails and fail-closed policy blocks the change."}
  ],
